title: Eriocitrin Mitigates Osteoarthritis Development by Suppressing Chondrocyte Inflammation and ECM Degradation via Nrf2/HO-1/NF-kappaB Pathways.
authors: Yang, Jin; Zheng, Wenhao; Mei, Yifan; Ni, Haifen; Liu, Huachen; Zhang, Yu; Li, Yangbo; Chen, Hua; Cai, Leyi; Tian, Naifeng; Wang, Jinwu
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然黄酮Eriocitrin通过Nrf2/HO-1/NF-kappaB通路缓解骨关节炎，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a chronic degenerative disorder of the joints, distinguished by ongoing damage and depletion of articular cartilage, synovial membrane inflammation, and extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation. Oxidative stress and chronic inflammation are central to OA progression, contributing to chondrocyte dysfunction, ECM degradation, and oxidative damage. Eriocitrin (Eri), a naturally derived flavonoid possessing substantial free-radical-scavenging and inflammation-modulating properties, has shown therapeutic potential; nevertheless, its specific function in OA remains ambiguous. In this study, we investigated the impact of Eri on interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta)-induced inflammation in murine chondrocytes and assessed its therapeutic efficacy in a murine OA model. Using network pharmacology, we identified 52 potential targets of Eri in OA. Molecular docking analysis revealed strong binding affinity between Eri and two critical regulators: nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and p65. Further experimental validation demonstrated that Eri activated the Nrf2 and heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) pathway to enhance antioxidant defenses, while simultaneously inhibited the nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) pathway to reduce inflammation. Specifically, Eri suppressed IL-1beta-induced inflammatory reactions in chondrocytes, reduced the secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines, and inhibited ECM degradation, thereby suppressing the progression of OA. In vivo, Eri significantly slowed cartilage degeneration, simultaneously mitigated chondrocyte inflammation and ECM breakdown in OA mice. Together, these findings indicate that Eri mitigates OA progression by targeting both oxidative stress and inflammation through the Nrf2/HO-1 and NF-kappaB pathways. This study provides a mechanistic basis for further exploration of Eri as a potential therapeutic agent for OA.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种慢性退行性关节疾病，其特征为关节软骨的持续损伤和耗竭、滑膜炎症以及细胞外基质（ECM）降解。氧化应激和慢性炎症是OA进展的核心因素，导致软骨细胞功能障碍、ECM降解和氧化损伤。Eriocitrin（Eri）是一种天然来源的黄酮类化合物，具有显著的清除自由基和调节炎症的特性，显示出治疗潜力；然而，其在OA中的具体作用仍不明确。在本研究中，我们探讨了Eri对白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）诱导的小鼠软骨细胞炎症的影响，并评估了其在小鼠OA模型中的治疗效果。通过网络药理学分析，我们确定了Eri在OA中的52个潜在靶点。分子对接分析显示，Eri与两个关键调控因子——核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）和p65——之间具有强结合亲和力。进一步的实验验证表明，Eri激活了Nrf2和血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路以增强抗氧化防御，同时抑制核因子κB（NF-κB）通路以减少炎症。具体而言，Eri抑制了IL-1β诱导的软骨细胞炎症反应，减少了促炎细胞因子的分泌，并抑制了ECM降解，从而抑制了OA的进展。在体内实验中，Eri显著减缓了软骨退化，同时减轻了OA小鼠的软骨细胞炎症和ECM分解。综合这些发现表明，Eri通过Nrf2/HO-1和NF-κB通路同时靶向氧化应激和炎症，从而缓解OA进展。本研究为Eri作为OA潜在治疗药物的进一步探索提供了机制基础。
